text:
kevin: Quick sync — Q2 hosted API capacity planning. We have a marketing-driven mobile push + new integrations that could cause ~35% sustained traffic uplift for 4–6 weeks starting mid-June. Need proposals that balance cost, lead time, and region constraints (APAC shortage). Looking for recommended mix of short-term rentals vs buys, and an estimate of extra GPU-hours and cost.

anika: Working from our baseline: current fleet steady-state = 240 A100-80GB equiv across regions. Our telemetry shows avg GPU utilization at 62% and median seq len 256. If traffic +35% the rough extra demand: ~240 * 0.35 * 24 * 7 = ~14,112 GPU-hours/week.

kevin: Can you drop a compact plan with hard numbers (rent vs buy) and month cost? Need to present to finance tomorrow.

anika: Short version:
- APAC: immediate shortage on new orders (manufacturer lead times >10w). Recommend short-cycle rentals (cloud-on-demand or colo racks) for peak weeks. Proposal: 12 rented A100-80GB equiv in APAC for 6 weeks.
- EU: consider buying 8 used A100-80GB (tested refurb market) to provide runway and lower ongoing costs.
- NA: cover with existing buffer + 6-week spot-burst on our reserved pool.

Estimated incremental capacity and cost (ballpark):
```
Extra GPU-hours/week required: 14,112
APAC rentals: 12 GPUs * 24 * 7 = 2,016 GPU-hrs/week -> 6 weeks = 12,096 hrs
EU buys: 8 GPUs * 24 * 7 = 1,344 GPU-hrs/week -> purchase amortized over 24 months
NA spot burst: 6 GPUs * 24 * 7 = 1,008 GPU-hrs/week
```
Cost assumptions: rental rate = $5.50 / GPU-hr (colo w/ power), used purchase avg = $30k / GPU (incl shipping), amortized = ~$52 / GPU-hr over 24 months assuming 600 hrs/month. Spot/NA burst avg = $2.5 / GPU-hr.

Estimated 6-week marginal cost:
- APAC rentals: 12,096 hrs * $5.5 = $66,528
- NA spot bursts: 6 weeks * 1,008 * $2.5 = $15,120
- EU buys (3-year TCO amortized for presentation): 8 * $30k = $240k (capex) -> show as amortized $6,666/mo for 36 months (~$40k for 6 weeks equivalent)
Net incremental for campaign window ~= $66.5k + $15.1k + $40k ~= $121.6k (plus incidental ops)

david: Two operational notes: 1) renting in APAC needs confirmed cross-connect and egress budget — egress could double if traffic outbound is heavy. 2) Rack/cab density in our preferred APAC colo is limited; 12 GPUs might need 3 separate cabinets which adds setup fees.

maria: On model side we can reduce token compute ~10–15% by enabling group quantization/LLM.int8 path on non-critical endpoints for the 6-week window. That reduces required extra GPU-hours to ~12,700/wk instead of 14,112, trimming ~$12k from rental spend. Would require a canary and regression evals (2 days).

sre-jen: Also flagging network constraints: some APAC regions have MTR limits on colo-to-cloud VPNs; prefer colocated inference for latency-sensitive endpoints. For EU buys, verify our on-prem PDUs and power headroom — procurement flagged max 18A per rack. If we exceed, we'll need PD upgrades (~$6k one-time).

kevin: Good. Two alternative scenarios for finance slide:
A) Minimal CapEx: all short-term rentals + NA spot = ~6-week cost $90–130k depending on quantization. No long-term commitment.
B) Hybrid: buy 8 EU GPUs + rent APAC + spot NA = higher capex (~$240k) but expected payback in ~9–12 months vs pure rental.

ops-bot: Capacity reservation created: request_id=cap-req-2003456789. Pending vendor confirmation for APAC racks.

anika: Action items:
- Anika: finalize rental vendor quotes today (rack/cost/egress).
- David: validate APAC cross-connect feasibility and rack count by EOD.
- Maria: run quantization canary on staging and 50k eval tokens by tomorrow noon.
- Jen: confirm PDU/power headroom for EU racks and estimated upgrade cost.

kevin: I'll bundle numbers into the finance slide after vendor quotes. If any blocker on vendor lead time, call it out ASAP — we need signed options by next Tue to have rentals in place by mid-June. :thumbsup:
